prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the best attorney for you depends on your injuries, the facts, insurance issues, whether the case may require trial, and how you prefer to work with your lawyer. I can help you find one, but here’s a practical way to choose and some next steps.

How to pick the right Chicago car‑accident attorney
- Experience with car-accident claims and trial experience (if your case may go to court).  
- Record of results: settlements and verdicts in cases like yours (ask for examples).  
- Client communication: promptness, who will handle the case (partner or junior associate).  
- Resources: ability to retain investigators, accident reconstructionists, medical experts.  
- Fees and costs: contingency fee rate, who advances expenses, how medical liens are handled.  
- Reputation and discipline: peer reviews (Martindale‑Hubbell, Super Lawyers), client reviews, and clean disciplinary record with the Illinois Attorney Registration & Disciplinary Commission (ARDC).  

Where to search
- Illinois State Bar / ARDC for licensing and discipline records.  
- Local trial lawyer associations (Illinois Association of Justice / Cook County bar lists).  
- Lawyer-rating sites: Martindale, Super Lawyers, Avvo, Google reviews — use them as one data point, not the only one.  

Questions to ask in a free consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? What were the outcomes?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day? How will you communicate updates?  
- What is your contingency fee and what costs will I be responsible for?  
- Do you have experience taking cases to trial? Any relevant verdicts?  
- How long will this probably take and what should I expect for settlement value/range?  

Red flags
- Promises of a specific dollar amount up front.  
- Reluctance to explain fees or if they won’t put terms in writing.  
- Poor communication or difficulty reaching the attorney/firm.  
- Numerous disciplinary complaints.

Well‑regarded Chicago firms (examples to consider)
- Clifford Law Offices — long-established, high-profile plaintiff personal-injury practice.  
- Levin & Perconti — experienced personal-injury trial lawyers in Chicago.  
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard — handles serious injury/car-accident cases.  
- Simmons Hanly Conroy — national firm with major personal-injury practice (Illinois roots).  
- Power Rogers & Smith — Chicago firm handling personal injury and auto claims.

(Those are examples of reputable firms as of 2024; you should still confirm current status, results, and fit.)

If you want, I can:
- Help narrow this to a short list of attorneys based on your case details (severity of injuries, fault dispute, insurer conduct, date/place of crash).  
- Provide a printable list of questions to bring to consultations.  
Tell me a few facts about the crash (injury level, at-fault issues, major insurers involved, any deadlines) and I’ll help you narrow the search and draft questions to ask.
